# Roleplay Rule 3 ## Type with proper grammar in in-character text chat.
- Use correct [color=#b8860b]capitalization[/color], [color=#b8860b]punctuation[/color], and [color=#b8860b]spelling[/color] in all in-character (IC) communication to the best of your ability. - Avoid using [color=#d93c3c]contemporary internet slang[/color], abbreviations (e.g., "brb," "pls," "tf"), or text emojis (e.g., ":D," ":)") in IC chat. While some common slang and abbreviations may be automatically converted to proper words, not all are covered—so always strive to use proper language yourself. - Strive for [color=#2e9e4f]clarity[/color] and [color=#2e9e4f]immersion[/color] in your IC writing.
[italic][color=#2e9e4f]Good grammar helps everyone understand and enjoy the story.[/color][/italic]
